tagline: AI Rap Generator – Solo Rap Video from Your Photo
description: For Solo Rap, add a JPG, PNG, or WebP portrait of one clearly visible adult, enter a topic, pick one of five scenes (Kitchen, Recording Studio, Street Freestyle, Neon Stage, or Spotlight Solo), and choose an aspect ratio. The model writes original English rap lyrics and creates the beat, vocals, background, and movement. Requested format is a 12-second 720p video. Rap Battle uses two portraits and a rivalry topic. Generation requires a verified account and uses 100 credits per completed video. Packs: 100 credits $1.99, 400 $4.99, 1,000 $9.99. Credits never expire. No free credit pack is listed.
